reason: B proposes the more physically credible intervention: Ti is a reactive wetting/adhesion layer capable of improving W–Cu interfacial bonding, whereas A’s CoCrFeNiCu layer may itself segregate and its “high mixing entropy” rationale and cited evidence do not establish stability or compatibility at a W–Cu interface.
